newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH STATE JAN-JULY REVENUE UP 24.5 PCT YR/YR.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH STATE JAN-JULY REVENUE UP 24.5 PCT YR/YR.

text.p: Finnish state revenue excluding borrowing increased 24.5 percent year-on-year in January-July to 101.91 billion markka, the finance ministry said in a statement received on Wednesday.
State expenditure excluding debt amortisation fell 5.2 percent to 125.67 billion.
The rise in revenues was exceptionally big due to last year's extraordinary factors which kept tax revenue low, the ministry said.
State income tax revenue rose 34.4 percent year-on-year to 25.20 billion markka in January-July while total income tax collected rose 12.9 percent to 72.67 billion markka.
Value-added tax revenue increased 25.4 percent to 25.32 billion markka in January-July.
State revenue from accise duries rose 5.6 percent to 13.23 billion markka and car tax revenue surged 36.6 percent to 2.28 billion markka.

On the expenditure side, state transfers to local governments fell 15.9 percent to 20.98 bilion markka, transfers to industry and business fell 14.1 percent to 9.04 bilion and transfers to households fell five percent to 25.56 billion markka.
State debt servicing costs increased 15.6 percent year-on-year to 19.63 billion markka.

The central government's net financing requirement including items outside the budget was 23.8 billion markka in January-July -- 26.9 billion markka less than in the corresponding period in 1995, the finance ministry said.

State net borrowing amounted to 34.32 billion markka in January-July, it said, adding state debt rose to 408 billion markka by the end of August from 403 billion at end-July and 366 billion at end-1995.
